name: Policy Application Lifecycle
description: Registers a test application with Policy, retrieves it, then deletes it. Exercises the full application management lifecycle through the gateway. Policy derives application_id deterministically from display_name ('Plot Test Application' → 'plot-test-application'), so no capture is needed and the plot is fully idempotent — step 1 cleans up any orphan from a prior run before registering fresh.
author: seti

steps.description: Pre-cleanup — delete any orphaned test application from a prior run. 200 = cleaned up, 404 = nothing to clean, both pass.
Register the test application — ID is derived as 'plot-test-application'
Retrieve the registered application by its deterministic ID
Delete the test application — no orphans
